title: proc-sim-agent: Claude Code plugins for chemical process simulation
description: Claude Code plugins that ground answers about process simulation software in the user's own locally installed product help, simulation files and literature. The first plugin covers Aspen Plus: full-text index of the local help, run-history, report and Control Panel parsers, inline-Fortran checks, model review and version comparison, and a curated knowledge base of run messages and calculator practice. No vendor content is distributed.
